description: Analysis-stage evaluation suite. Each task drives the agent through a small end-to-end simulation (setup, plan, execute autonomously) and then evaluates analysis behavior — default per-shape order parameters at L1, interpretation at L2, custom extra_order_params at L3, mixture extras at L4, and an adversarial inappropriate-order-parameter request at L5. Build the 'full' skill variant before running: python eval/build_skill_variant.py --variant-id full

user_profiles.description: Cares more about interpreting outputs, order parameters, and summary conclusions than setup details.
Uses incomplete, slightly inconsistent, or poorly phrased requests to test robustness.

metadata.execution_note: Each task runs a small simulation (100–200 particles, sample_steps=5000–10000). Expect 1–3 minutes per task on a typical workstation.
